about: Niacin is supplied four times from April to August 2026 for a man aged 66. The four planted lines use the ingredient name niacin.
Nicotinic acid (niacin) is supplied three times in the middle of a 14-month history for a woman aged 72.
Nicotinamide (a different form of vitamin B3, not niacin) is supplied monthly, so nothing must flag.
